scientific_integrity: The 910-case finite rational proof is verified by a standalone standard-library checker; the finite list covers infinite real input by an explicit sign-polyhedral reduction. Source dates and claimed previous results were checked separately.
scientific_limitations: Exact depth-three contraction for real, equal-mass, mean-centered L1 binary-tree BMO; depth-four counterexample established independently from the published 16-leaf witness. Does not determine the depth-four or infinite-depth optimal constants. Exact finite dual-certificate proof, independently auditable but not independently audited.
title: The first amplification depth for absolute values in binary tree BMO
